title: azorella minuta
intro: Azorella minuta, commonly known as Chilean wormwood or Andean wormwood, is a perennial plant native to the high-altitude regions of South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Azorella minuta include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties.
